title: The Otters Who Held Paws All Night 🦦🌊
yt_title: The Otters Who Held Paws All Night 🦦🌊
yt_description:
"Holding paws? That's so silly!" Sid the seagull woke up next to a lighthouse. 🌊
Sea otters sleep floating on the water, and to keep from drifting apart they hold paws or wrap themselves in kelp. (Otto, Lulu and Sid are fictional; the science is real.)

Sources: Discover Magazine; A-Z Animals.

caption:
"Holding paws? That's so silly!" 🦦🌊 Sid the seagull woke up very, very far away.
Sea otters really hold paws or wrap in kelp so they don't drift apart while they sleep.

script: Every night, Otto the otter holds Lulu's paw... and falls asleep on the sea. Sid: Ha! Holding paws? That's so silly! Otto: It's not silly. It's smart. That night, the waves get bigger. Everybody drifts. Sid: Wheee! I'm fine! I'm free! In the morning, Otto and Lulu are still together. And Sid? He wakes up next to a lighthouse. Very far away. Sid: Uh... where am I? Sea otters really do this: they sleep on the water, and to keep from drifting apart, they hold paws or wrap themselves in kelp. And tonight? Sid holds a paw too.
